extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants and institutional staff preparing/attaching Biographical Sketch Supplements (PIs, senior/key personnel, research administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for completing and submitting the NIH Biographical Sketch Supplement (the Common Form section that collects Personal Statement, Contributions to Science, and Honors) as part of NIH grant applications and progress reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: One of three required NIH-specific data elements collected by the Biographical Sketch Supplement: Personal Statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Personal Statement information is used to assess qualifications and documents an individual's qualifications and experience for a specific role in a project. (Presented on the Biographical Sketch Supplement Common Form.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributions to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: One of three required NIH-specific data elements collected by the Biographical Sketch Supplement: Contributions to Science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributions to Science entries document an individual's scientific contributions and are used by reviewers to assess qualifications and relevance to the proposed project. (Presented on the Biographical Sketch Supplement Common Form.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: One of three required NIH-specific data elements collected by the Biographical Sketch Supplement: Honors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Honors list notable recognitions and awards and are used to document the individual's qualifications and standing relevant to the application role. (Presented on the Biographical Sketch Supplement Common Form.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose and use of collected information
rubrics_metrics.description: Information collected (Personal Statement, Contributions to Science, and Honors) is used to assess qualifications and documents an individual's qualifications and experience for a specific role in a project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This explanatory purpose clarifies that the supplement's elements are evaluated to determine suitability for a particular project role during peer review and administrative checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Common Forms (system enforcement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of the Common Forms for Biographical Sketch, Current and Pending (Other) Support, and NIH Biographical Sketch Supplement is required and system-enforced for all application due dates and JIT, RPPR, and Prior Approval submissions on or after May 8, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The leniency period described in NOT-OD-26-033 ends May 7, 2026. On May 8, 2026, system warnings will change to errors that will stop any submission not using compliant Common Forms. See NOT-OD-26-079, NOT-OD-26-033, and related notices for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: SciENcv preparation and workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: SciENcv must be used to prepare the Biographical Sketch Supplement; provide Biographical Sketch Supplement information in the second section of the NIH Biographical Sketch Common Form interface and complete both forms through one user interface.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Download the completed PDF forms from SciENcv, then attach the forms to your applications and progress reports. Find additional tips about SciENcv in NOT-OD-26-018. (This is a mandatory preparation and submission workflow requirement.)

rubrics_metrics.name: ORCID ID requirement and linking
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants are required to have an ORCID ID and link it with their eRA Commons profiles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a mandatory data/identity requirement referenced on the page as a reminder—ensure ORCID is obtained and linked as part of applicant profile setup prior to submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location of Biographical Sketch Supplement data entry
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide NIH Biographical Sketch Supplement information in the second section of the NIH Biographical Sketch Common Form interface.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Biographical Sketch Supplement is completed through the same SciENcv/Common Form user interface as the Biographical Sketch; download the combined PDFs from SciENcv for attachment to applications and progress reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of detailed instructions (resource requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for the Biographical Sketch Supplement are provided in a PDF (linked on the page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the 'Instructions for Biographical Sketch Supplement (PDF, 217 KB)' and the 'Common Forms Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)' linked on the page for detailed field-level guidance and examples when preparing the supplement.
